entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Theodoric's Ostrogothic Kingdom, a political institution in Italy during Early Medieval Italy (476–774). Grew from Diocletian. Led to the emergence of Ostrogoths, Byzantines, and Lombards and Lombard.
